messages.subject: Re: Error runing Random Forests in Rattle
parts:
Thanks for the bug report Wayne.

The problem is with the randomForest package and is affecting a lot of
Rattle users. The author is aware of the problem. The best solution is
to get an older version of randomForest. For convenience I've put
older versions on the togaware site for people to access:

http://rattle.togaware.com/randomForest_4.5-23.tar.gz
http://rattle.togaware.com/randomForest_4.5-20.zip

Regards,
Graham
